speaker: Jon Anik
summary: Jon Anik argues that Gaethje's legacy is defined more by his violence and highlight-reel moments than by all-time lightweight status, and admits Gaethje may already have fought his last bout.
quote: I still think that there's a chance we've seen the last of Justin Gaethje.

speaker: Arman Tsarukyan
summary: Arman Tsarukyan says Ilia Topuria timed his statement to pressure the UFC title picture, but Tsarukyan believes his performance removed any doubt that he is next for the belt.
quote: there is no doubt that I'm fighting for the title next.

speaker: Arman Tsarukyan
summary: Tsarukyan confirms he has been told his next fight is for a belt and argues Gaethje would rather fight Topuria than him because Gaethje already beat Topuria once.
quote: If they give him the opportunity to pick me or he would pick Ilia because he know how he already beat him.

speaker: Ariel Helwani
summary: Ariel Helwani argues Arman Tsarukyan may need more than just a win because Ilia Topuria’s return could push the UFC toward an immediate Justin Gaethje rematch, while a loss could bury Arman in the lightweight title picture.
quote: I think the UFC would be inclined to give him an immediate rematch against Justin Gaethje given his popularity and how much they love him.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Chael Sonnen says the proposed Ilia Topuria vs. Justin Gaethje title fight drew unusually strong backlash from fans who felt it could not be justified competitively.
quote: That fight with Ilia and Gaethje was met with more resistance from our community than any potential title fight that I can recall and definitely by any rematch.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen says Dana White still appears bothered by Arman Tsarukyan’s late withdrawal against Islam Makhachev and that Tsarukyan may still be paying for it despite serving as a backup fighter.
quote: I think he might still be paying a penance for what I view as an old crime.

speaker: Craig Jones
summary: Craig Jones says he predicted Ilia Topuria could get an immediate rematch because Topuria waited strategically to make his first post-fight statement.
quote: I think an immediate rematch is a very good possibility.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Chael Sonnen argues that Paddy Pimblett is arguably the UFC's biggest star but says Ilia Topuria's two-division credentials make him impossible to deny for a title fight.
quote: I don't know how anybody could with credibility say that Ilia Topuria does not deserve to fight for the very belt that he just held.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Chael Sonnen agrees with Sean O'Malley's view that Ilia Topuria could have finished Justin Gaethje, arguing Topuria mainly lost because a year of inactivity and major life changes left him unable to maintain his pace for 25 minutes.
quote: Ilia did not lose that fight for any reason greater than he had not competed for a year.

speaker: Jon Anik
summary: Jon Anik says Arman Tsarukyan has become impossible to overlook for the next lightweight title opportunity, although he believes Justin Gaethje would still have a legitimate chance against him.
quote: Arman Tsarukyan has made himself so undeniable that I think promotionally you really can't go in another direction.

speaker: Jon Anik
summary: Jon Anik explains why the UFC may seriously consider a rematch between Ilia Topuria and Justin Gaethje, while arguing that Tsarukyan's latest win makes him deserving of the title fight.
quote: Internally you have to at least kick the tires on that rematch.

speaker: Jon Anik
summary: Jon Anik questions whether Gaethje will continue his career and predicts that the UFC will book him against Tsarukyan if he accepts, while noting Tsarukyan is already a major betting favorite.
quote: I believe that the UFC will make that fight if Justin Gaethje is willing.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje discusses being a massive underdog against Ilia Topuria and reveals that a friend bet $320,000 on him across multiple sportsbooks and won around $1.1 million.
quote: My buddy Greg put 200 I got to the house, he's like, "I put 320,000 on you. I won 1.1 million or something."

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje says beating Topuria came from his mindset, experience, Trevor Wittman’s game plan, and Topuria being in a bad mental spot.
quote: It was a mixture of, you know, my mindset, my experience, my coach's game plan, and then him being in a bad spot mentally.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje agrees that Topuria’s confidence and ego grew during fight week and says he warned Topuria that his approach could backfire.
quote: I was like, "Hey, you're doing this wrong, man. Like this could this could fire this could backfire."

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje defends Ilia Topuria as world-class despite fan criticism, but questions whether Topuria can remain at lightweight.
quote: I'm not sure he can stay at at lightweight, but, you know, we're going to find out.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje says Ilia Topuria had a fight date scheduled and was ready to compete, but aggravated his eye injury during training, which led to Ciryl Gane becoming champion.
quote: He was ready to fight and it got injury reaggravated. Now Ciryl Gane is the champ.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje says Ilia Topuria’s knockouts of Charles Oliveira and Max Holloway made him train with urgency and avoid being embarrassed in front of his family.
quote: Every day I woke up inspired to not let this fool knock me out in front of my family.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Asked about a potential Ilia Topuria vs. Paddy Pimblett fight, Justin Gaethje calls Paddy a confusing and unique matchup who is hard to beat if given space.
quote: If you fight Paddy with space, I think he's hard to beat.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje says Paddy Pimblett is a serious problem and wants to see him fight Ilia Topuria because of the matchup and trash-talk history.
quote: No, Paddy Paddy's a problem.

speaker: Arman Tsarukyan
summary: Tsarukyan reveals the UFC told him both before and after the fight that they are working on his title shot.
quote: After fight they told me same.

speaker: Arman Tsarukyan
summary: Tsarukyan predicts Ilia Topuria’s team will try to jump him for a title shot but says it will not happen, and expects Topuria to fight Paddy Pimblett instead while Justin Gaethje may demand big money or retire.
quote: They're going to try, but it's not going to happen.

speaker: Arman Tsarukyan
summary: Tsarukyan dismisses Topuria’s concerns about the gloves as impossible under commission oversight and calls it an excuse for losing.
quote: It's just excuse, brother.

speaker: Arman Tsarukyan
summary: Arman Tsarukyan says his main goal is the UFC title and maps out a potential run of Gaethje, Paddy Pimblett, and Ilia Topuria title fights.
quote: Gaethje and then Paddy Pimblett.

speaker: Bear Degidio
summary: Bear Degidio contrasts Maurício Ruffy’s difficult upbringing with Arman Tsarukyan’s privileged background and argues that Arman deserves exceptional respect for maintaining elite performances without the same financial motivation.
quote: Arman doesn't have that same motivation, but yet he's still showing up like this and putting on those kind of performances.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Chael Sonnen emphatically rejects the idea that Ilia Topuria will return to featherweight, while citing Justin Gaethje’s view that Topuria is too small for lightweight.
quote: But size matters and he's not big enough to be in the lightweight category.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen predicts Topuria would not leave lightweight if he hits adversity there and would only consider featherweight after winning the 155-pound belt.
quote: If Ilia ran into a problem at 55, by the own standard, his own code that he will live and die by, he will stay at 55 until he solves that problem.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen says anyone trying to pitch Team Topuria on a featherweight return should not bother unless Topuria has already recaptured the lightweight title.
quote: If you think that Ilia is going back to 45, he might, but it will not be until he recaptures the title at 155.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Chael Sonnen says Arman Tsarukyan told him a five-round fight benefits him because he can teach Dan Hooker’s replacement opponent more over 25 minutes than 15.
quote: It's better for him if I can hold class for 25 minutes instead of 15.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Chael Sonnen argues the lightweight matchup should be treated as a true number-one contender fight and cites Justin Gaethje’s request to face someone new.
quote: Why can't we have a number one contenders match?

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen predicts Arman Tsarukyan will win, but says the fight will likely go deep and the only path to an upset is a finish.
quote: Arman is going to defeat him.

speaker: Denis Shkuratov
summary: The host says Ali Abdelaziz told him Ilia Topuria will not be next for Justin Gaethje and asks whether Arman Tsarukyan should be the next fight.
quote: Ali Abdelaziz told me it's not going to be Ilia next for Justin Gaethje.

speaker: Jon Anik
summary: Jon Anik reviews Gaethje's championship history and says another title defense may not be enough to place him among the greatest lightweights ever.
quote: I don't know that he's ever going to be regarded as the greatest lightweight of all time.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje says he saw Ilia Topuria react when an uppercut cut his eye early in the fight and immediately tried to capitalize.
quote: I saw him get cut. I saw him affected by it and I was like, "Sweet."

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje says Topuria is still one of the best in the world and wants to see him come back, thrive, and inspire people after the loss.
quote: Without those mental mistakes, you know, he is one of the best in the world.

speaker: Unidentified Double Coverage Podcast host
summary: The host says Bobby Green argued that Justin Gaethje’s résumé across WSOF, BMF, interim and undisputed titles makes him the greatest American champion ever.
quote: Justin Gaethje is the greatest American champion we've ever had.

speaker: Arman Tsarukyan
summary: Tsarukyan says he is not worried the UFC will change its mind because he stayed professional and proved he can knock people out.
quote: No, this time I was a good boy.

speaker: Arman Tsarukyan
summary: Arman Tsarukyan says he told UFC officials after his win that it is time for him to fight for the lightweight title.
quote: I said it's a time for the title and uh I showed the down there too that I need a title.

speaker: Ariel Helwani
summary: Ariel Helwani reads Paddy Pimblett’s criticism of Arman Tsarukyan’s performance and Paddy’s claim that he would still beat him.
quote: That was a statement, but I'd still punch his head in.

speaker: Arman Tsarukyan
summary: Arman Tsarukyan says Mauricio Ruffy would beat Paddy Pimblett in a striking fight and calls Ruffy the best striker in the lightweight division.
quote: I think Ruffy is the best striker in our division right now.

speaker: Arman Tsarukyan
summary: Arman Tsarukyan says Ilia Topuria vs. Paddy Pimblett is a 50/50 fight because Pimblett has a strong chin and cardio, making Topuria’s knockout path difficult.
quote: So, it's like 50/50.

speaker: Arman Tsarukyan
summary: Tsarukyan argues that fights with Paddy Pimblett, Ilia Topuria, or Charles Oliveira would be much bigger than his recent bout and predicts he will be among the UFC’s biggest stars within a year.
quote: Or Topuria, it could be like huge fight

speaker: Bear Degidio
summary: The hosts explain that Tsarukyan’s latest camp was unusually focused, with no streaming or goofing off, and praise him for continuing to push through painful training despite being able to stop at any time.
quote: There was no goofing off. There was no streaming.

speaker: Quinton Jackson
summary: Quinton Jackson highlights that Arman Tsarukyan made weight easily before the fight, prompting joking accusations that the hosts are defending their team.
quote: Arman made weight super easy.

speaker: Bear Degidio
summary: Bear praises the loyalty of Arman’s team and reveals that Arman helps financially support several fighters, while Hamzat Chimaev’s group assists around 20 Chechen prospects with training, housing and food.
quote: Arman, for example, he's got three or four guys that he basically funds and supports our entire fighting career with his manager, Pocho.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen argues Alexander Volkanovski lost to Islam Makhachev partly because keeping the featherweight belt meant he did not absolutely have to win at lightweight, and says Topuria will not make that mistake.
quote: I am convinced the reason the Volk did not beat Islam in the first fight, I'm convinced the reason the Volk was not the 155-pound champion is because he kept the 45-pound belt.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen says a Topuria versus Volkanovski rematch is fascinating, but insists Topuria will not return to featherweight until he is finished at lightweight.
quote: Ilia will not do it until he's completely done at 155.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen says the upcoming lightweight fight should determine the next title challenger unless it is a complete flop, and argues Gaethje deserves a fresh opponent if it is his final fight.
quote: If this really is his last fight and he's got one request which is give me someone new.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Chael Sonnen predicts Arman Tsarukyan will win a long fight that reaches the championship rounds.
quote: I do think that Arman's going to win.

speaker: Kacper Rosolowski
summary: The host says Justin Gaethje has transformed his legacy since UFC 300 by becoming the undisputed UFC lightweight champion.
quote: He's at least changed his legacy on paper that it's not just Mr. Highlight, right? It's undisputed UFC lightweight champion and a man who now has claimed the Ultimate Prize.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje says he will watch Arman Tsarukyan vs. Mauricio Ruffy closely as a potential lightweight contender fight, while calling Tsarukyan a wild card, especially with Khamzat Chimaev in his corner.
quote: Of course, but this sport is so fluid.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje says Topuria has the chance and ability to prove people wrong after the setback.
quote: He has the same opportunity to prove everybody wrong.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje responds to talk of a possible rematch involving Ilia Topuria by saying he is currently healing his hand and knee and expects to return after recovering.
quote: I'm back.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Gaethje praises Paddy Pimblett’s submission of BSD, saying BSD defended correctly but Paddy’s choke was still exceptional and unique.
quote: BSD did exactly what he was supposed to do when it comes to the defensive position and posture whenever someone grabs a you know, with that that choke.

speaker: Zack
summary: The host predicts Arman Tsarukyan will beat his opponent by decision and cement himself as the top lightweight contender near Justin Gaethje.
quote: I think Arman is a dark horse of this division, right there with Justin Gaethje.

speaker: Justin Gaethje
summary: Justin Gaethje says retirement is ultimately his decision, but he is injured, cannot fight again this year, and will likely discuss his future around Christmas.
quote: They know that I'm hurt right now. They know I can't fight again this year, so they kind of just want me to enjoy, you know, this, recover, rest, recover, enjoy what I have accomplished, and then, you know, I think we're all going to around Christmas time probably have a conversation about what's, you know, what's next.

speaker: Arman Tsarukyan
summary: Tsarukyan says Topuria’s loss could make him more motivated, hungrier, and better than before.
quote: Maybe he's going to be more motivated and more hungry and he's going to locked in and become a way better than he was before.

speaker: Bear Degidio
summary: Bear reveals that Arman Tsarukyan and his teammates kept the camp largely closed to outside media while giving JAXXON extensive access and support.
quote: They didn't involve media or any Americans or anybody really into their camp.

speaker: Chael Sonnen
summary: Sonnen disputes Gaethje’s size argument, saying he sees little difference between 145 and 155 and that cutting to 155 makes it hard to call Topuria small for the division.
quote: Like if you weigh more than the weight class, it's hard for me to believe that you're small for the weight class.

speaker: Jon Anik
summary: Jon Anik discusses UFC star power and says he considers Topuria a top-five UFC superstar.
quote: I see Poatan and Topuria as top five.

speaker: Zack
summary: The host says Justin Gaethje is attending the lightweight fight as a fan, not to trash-talk the winner, though he will still be watching closely.
quote: Gaethje's not going to get in there and talk trash.

speaker: Jon Anik
summary: Jon Anik compares Gable Steveson's setback to Ilia Topuria's recent loss and says he is curious to see how both respond.
quote: I'm as curious as anybody to see how he responds from this, to see how like Ilia Topuria responds to his recent loss.
